title: aalius quadrangularis
intro: Aalius quadrangularis, commonly known as "Yerba Mansa", is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues. The health benefits of Yerba Mansa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Yerba Mansa include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and promote wound healing.
